Model selection workflow figure

Source: R/figures.R
plot_model_selection.Rd

Produces a 3-panel figure showing the ICONIC model selection workflow on example data. Panels: (A) eligibility table from iconic_diagnose(), (B) NDE/NIE forest plot from iconic_estimate(), (C) degradation surface heatmap from iconic_sensitivity().

Usage

plot_model_selection(
  diagnosis,
  estimate,
  sensitivity,
  recommendation,
  file = NULL,
  width = 12,
  height = 14
)

Arguments

diagnosis

Result of iconic_diagnose().

estimate

Result of iconic_estimate().

sensitivity

Result of iconic_sensitivity().

recommendation

Result of iconic_recommend().

file

Optional file path to save the figure.

width

Figure width in inches.

height

Figure height in inches.

Value

A patchwork ggplot object.

Examples

if (check_torch_setup()) {
  data <- iconic_data(X = rnorm(100), Y = matrix(rnorm(100 * 10), 10, 100),
    M = rnorm(100), G = rnorm(100), Gm = rnorm(100),
    W = matrix(rnorm(100 * 10), 10, 100))
  diag <- iconic_diagnose(data)
  est <- iconic_estimate(data, diagnosis = diag)
  sens <- iconic_sensitivity(data, n_iter = 2, gan_epochs = 5,
    rho_G1_grid = c(0, 0.2), rho_G2_grid = c(0, 0.2))
  rec <- iconic_recommend(data, diagnosis = diag, estimate = est,
    sensitivity = sens, auto_sensitivity = FALSE)
  plot_model_selection(diag, est, sens, rec)
}
